Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

Next Thursday, each of you will display a research poster in the main hall. Visitors from other departments will walk around and ask you about your methods. Your poster must fit on a single board, so do not print anything larger than one meter wide. Your final grade for the poster will come from me, based on the rubric I posted online.
Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

For our museum field trip on Saturday, you'll spend the morning sketching three objects from the ancient pottery collection. After lunch, the museum's curator will hold a workshop on how archaeologists restore broken pottery. By the following Friday, please hand in a two-page reflection that compares two of the objects you sketched.

t7-ride.title: TPO7 Transfer — ride to the concert

lines.t: Are you still going to the concert downtown on Sunday?
I'd love to, but my car is in the repair shop until next week, and the buses don't run late on Sundays.
I can drive you. I'm going anyway.
Really? That would be great. I was worried I'd have to miss it.

options: It was a long day yesterday.
why: 업무 주제는 같지만 지금 끝낼지에 대한 답 아님
시작이 아니라 끝나는 시각 — 시간 종류 불일치
